name: EDLR 5480
title: Synthesizing and Sustaining Leadership Learning
description: Aspiring leaders will gain the knowledge and skills to: articulate how the core leadership competencies overlap; develop a comprehensive leadership theory of action using the micro-level theories of action developed for each course; self-assess leadership effectiveness using 360-degree feedback and change project experiences; define an "equity stance" within a macro-level leadership theory of action; articulate professional learning priorities and actions in a post-UCAPP leadership development plan; and define a vision for a short and long-term educational leadership future. Formerly offered as EDLR 5412.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
